name: EFLZ seamless world — region graph v1
comment: Region graph for the seamless streamed world (--world streamed). Every region wraps an EXISTING authored world at its REAL authored coordinates (no content was moved): spire_f1 = the canonical LevelArchitect Floor 1 (the LevelDoc path), city/ocean_base/surface_landmarks = the code-built Act-2 open-world lanes (builder ids). anchor = [x,y,z] world meters; radius = the content's authored footprint radius (XZ); loadRadius/unloadRadius = residency hysteresis measured from the FOOTPRINT EDGE (load when closer than loadRadius, unload only when farther than unloadRadius — the gap stops boundary thrash). loadRadius is tuned generously for VEHICLE traversal (~40 m/s drive => 8-12 s of stream lead time).
